items.title: Modern Geometric Mandala Lattice Screen Vector File for Laser Cutting
items.description: Scale up your custom interior projects with this mesmerizing geometric mandala lattice pattern. Featuring sharp intersecting circular arcs and clean radiating lines, this vector file creates a breathtaking modern kaleidoscope screen. Flawlessly prepared in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, it is ready for high-speed laser cutting, CNC wood carving, and MDF engraving for partitions and feature walls.
